summary: Return host system uptime in seconds with Node-compatible numeric semantics.

semantics.monotonic_expectation: normally nondecreasing but host/runtime behavior is authoritative

caveats: Do not confuse system uptime with process uptime or Stopwatch elapsed time.

tests.name: edge distinct from process uptime
tests.expected_behavior: the first value represents system uptime while the second represents this process's age; lowering must not substitute one for the other
